name: Attunement to the Core
label: Quest
description: Attunement to the Core: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Rifts stir, tear, and collapse all around us, traveler. Not two paces from where I stand is a tear leading through the depths of Blackrock Mountain, into the maw of the Firelord.
Surprised? Pity... The mortal races cannot comprehend that which they cannot see, touch, or feel.
I assure you, the portal is there and access is possible.
I've piqued your interest? Attunement is simple. Venture into Blackrock Depths and retrieve a core fragment. Return it to me and I shall attune your essence with the portal.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You must attune your soul with the Molten Core before access is granted.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I am now able to transport you to the Molten Core. Ask and it shall be done.
